blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur—Parts of Ilocos Norte will experience a six-hour power supply interruption on Sunday, November 8, as the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) conducts maintenance work on its transmission facilities. The scheduled power supply interruption will run from 4:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., affecting areas served by the Ilocos Norte Electric Cooperative, Inc. (INEC), particularly those covered by the Pila, Venvi, Payas, Lang-ayan, Badoc, and Batac substations. NGCP said the power supply interruption is necessary for maintenance activities along the Bantay-Currimao 115kV transmission line and hotspot correction at the Currimao Substation.
